components.name: site-header
components.behaviors: Displays the site name/logo; remains static across pages.

components.name: primary-nav
components.behaviors: Horizontal link list; collapses to a hamburger button on viewports ≤ 600 px. ARIA‑expanded toggles visibility; ESC closes mobile menu and returns focus to the button.
components.keyboardExpectations: Enter/Space on hamburger toggles menu; Escape closes menu and focuses hamburger.

components.name: hero-banner
components.behaviors: Prominent introductory section with heading and optional text.

components.name: site-footer
components.behaviors: Contains copyright information and simple navigation links.

components.name: card-grid
components.behaviors: Responsive grid of cards displaying items (programs, courses, news, visit options). Cards can be hidden via JavaScript search or filter.
components.keyboardExpectations: None; keyboard interaction occurs via associated inputs (search, filter buttons).

components.name: sidebar
components.behaviors: Secondary content area; in this replica shows a list of faculty/staff.

components.name: contact-form
components.behaviors: Collects name, email, and message; on submit shows a toast thank‑you message and resets the form (demo only).
components.keyboardExpectations: Enter on a focused field submits the form; focus moves to toast after submit (simulated).

components.name: filter-bar
components.behaviors: Set of buttons that filter the news card grid by category; ARIA‑pressed indicates active button.
components.keyboardExpectations: Enter/Space on a button toggles its pressed state and updates the filter.

components.name: faq
components.behaviors: Definition list of questions and answers.

components.name: application-form
components.behaviors: Demo application form; on submit shows a toast and resets the form (no data stored).
components.keyboardExpectations: Enter on a focused field submits the form.

components.name: program-search
components.behaviors: Filters the program card grid in real time based on entered text (case‑insensitive substring match).
components.keyboardExpectations: Typing updates results immediately; Escape clears the input and shows all items.

components.name: course-search
components.behaviors: Filters the course card grid in real time based on entered text (case‑insensitive substring match).
components.keyboardExpectations: Typing updates results immediately; Escape clears the input and shows all items.
